records.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production creature model front reference for M10, PNG, native 1536 x 1024 landscape.
Recipe: single full-body FRONT view, neutral pose, orthographic-like straight frontal camera at the creature's low body height, very slightly above the shell lip so the front and carapace are legible. Key light: soft neutral studio light from upper left. Entire empty background flat light grey #E9E9EC, no gradient, texture, vignette, ground line, border or frame; only a small pale contact shadow under grounded legs. The creature alone fills most of the canvas height and width without cutting off a claw, leg, or tail. No person, silhouette, scale mark, inset, extra view or extra creature.

Subject construction: a low sea-dwelling crab-and-eel Hush-spawn. Flat, broad, slick BLACK-GREY crab carapace, 80 cm nose-to-rear length and 40 cm high in its ordinary crouch. EXACTLY TWO large serrated pincer claws in front, separately attached on chunky jointed crab arms. EXACTLY SIX slender SPINY WALKING LEGS, THREE on each side, behind the claw arms; separate them and show their roots and grounded pointed tips clearly. This is six walking legs PLUS two claw arms, eight articulated appendages total. All legs have credible crab joints and support the low heavy carapace. There is NO HEAD perched on the shell, NO EYES, eye stalks, eye sockets or red eye-like spots. One dark ROUND suction-like mouth hangs centrally UNDER the front lip of the carapace, pointed toward the viewer, with a single irregular ring of long thin off-white NEEDLE TEETH. It is a circular mouth opening, never a horizontal smile or human jaw. Keep the mouth lower than the shell edge.
One continuous muscular EEL TAIL emerges only from the rear of the shell, tapering in a sinuous horizontal S curve behind the body and out to one side, its full one-metre length visible, about 1.25 times the carapace's length. The tail has a low eel fin edge, supple and smooth, never a scorpion segmented tail, stinger, tentacle cluster or lobster abdomen.
Muted slate-black shell flats with one broad cool hard-edged shadow, a few short crisp wet highlights. Three or four violet Hush fissures along the top of the carapace, black-violet #1A1026 inside and muted violet ash #6B4C9A escaping as only a few small hard-edged flakes. A few small clusters of off-white barnacles and dark olive seaweed attached organically on the shell; sparse broken ink/dry-brush texture, not all-over grain. Menacing, animal, never cute, chunky stylized comic ink, not 3D. Mouth, claws and six legs visually distinct.

A brine crawler: a dog-sized sea monster, an 80 cm flat slick black-grey crab carapace with two serrated claws and six spiny legs, and a 1 m eel's tail behind; a round needle-toothed mouth under the shell; no eyes; violet cracks in the carapace leaking ash; weed and barnacles.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
records.reason: Overly rendered mottled shell and streaky tail; excessive micro-highlights and cast shadow pool; require large flat cel-colour regions.
